_comment: Saskatoon venue directory. Editable without an app update: changes ship in the next feed build. Every non-null field is backed by the source listed in `evidence`. Coordinates are only filled from a cited source; missing ones are geocoded by the ingest job (OpenStreetMap Nominatim) and marked coordSource=nominatim. Fields that could not be verified are null, never guessed.

venues.name: Amigos Cantina
venues.typicalAge: 19+ for most evening shows (stated per event, e.g. '19+ w/ Valid ID')
venues.notes: Tex-Mex restaurant by day, live music venue at night; also weekly trivia (Wednesdays). Ticketing on tickets.amigoscantina.com.
venues.verificationNotes: Address per Discover Saskatoon (Tourism Saskatoon) Broadway guide. An older travel listing gives 632 10th St E; the venue is on the corner of 10th St & Dufferin. Official site does not print a street address on the events page.

venues.name: Black Cat Tavern
venues.typicalAge: 19+ (stated on most event listings, 'Ages: 19+ I.D. Required')
venues.notes: Rock/punk/metal shows plus drag trivia, karaoke, art nights and bingo. Event calendar is an Elfsight widget on the official site. Previously the site of Vangelis Tavern.
venues.verificationNotes: Address and phone from the official website and the venue's own Elfsight location list.

venues.name: Capitol Music Club
aliases: Capitol Music Club, 244 1st Ave N, Saskatoon, Saskatchewan
venues.typicalAge: Mostly 19+; some 16+ and all-ages shows are labelled per event
venues.notes: Touring and local acts, tributes, comedy and club nights. Tickets via Showpass.
venues.verificationNotes: Website domain from Songkick venue page; address from SaskMusic directory and AllEvents. Official site could not be loaded during research, so its events page is not used as a source yet.

venues.name: The Bassment
venues.typicalAge: All ages (Saskatoon Jazz Society describes it as an all-ages venue)
venues.notes: Jazz, blues, roots and singer-songwriter shows run by the Saskatoon Jazz Society, 150+ shows a year. No-cover Piano Fridays. Tickets via Eventbrite.
venues.verificationNotes: Site moved to Squarespace; its JSON endpoints are disallowed by robots.txt, so events come from Songkick/Eventbrite listings.

venues.name: Broadway Theatre
venues.typicalAge: Varies by event; many shows all ages
venues.notes: Community-owned repertory cinema and live venue: concerts, comedy, improv, film. Also sells tickets for Winterruption festival shows at other venues.
venues.verificationNotes: Event list is server-rendered on the official site.

venues.name: Louis'
venues.address: Memorial Union Building (lower level), 93 Campus Dr, University of Saskatchewan, Saskatoon, SK S7N 5A4
venues.notes: USSU-run campus pub and concert room.
venues.verificationNotes: Address from the Black Cat Tavern Elfsight location list (venue-supplied); website from the same.

venues.name: Louis' Loft
venues.address: Memorial Union Building (upper level), 93 Campus Dr, University of Saskatchewan, Saskatoon, SK S7N 5A4
venues.notes: Smaller upstairs room at Louis'.
venues.verificationNotes: From the Black Cat Tavern Elfsight location list.

venues.name: Coors Event Centre
venues.notes: Mid-size concert room; open mic nights listed on SaskMusic.
venues.verificationNotes: Address and website from the Black Cat Tavern Elfsight location list.

venues.name: Buds on Broadway
venues.notes: Established 1983; live classic rock & blues Wednesday to Sunday, Saturday jam sessions.
venues.verificationNotes: SaskMusic directory and Discover Saskatoon (2025 nightlife guide). No official event calendar found.

venues.name: Somewhere Else Pub & Grill
venues.address: 2605 Broadway Ave S, Saskatoon, SK S7J 0Z5
venues.notes: Neighbourhood pub with local bands, acoustic open mic, bluegrass brunch, Tuesday trivia; hosts Saskatoon Blues Society events.
venues.verificationNotes: SaskMusic directory; events seen in SaskMusic listings (2026) and Eventbrite trivia listings.

venues.name: High Key Brewing Co.
venues.notes: Taproom; monthly 'Taproom Collective' showcasing local artists.
venues.verificationNotes: Address from SaskCulture event listing (June 2026); website from Bandsintown venue page.

venues.name: Prairie Sun Brewery
venues.notes: Brewpub with occasional live music and trivia. Occupies the former Lydia's Pub corner.
venues.verificationNotes: Tourism Saskatchewan lists 650 Broadway Ave. SeatGeek still shows the old 2020 Quebec Ave address (outdated, not used).

venues.name: Shelter Brewing Company
venues.notes: Nano-brewery taproom; taco + brew nights.
venues.verificationNotes: Discover Saskatoon brewery walking tour (2023) and Tourism Saskatchewan listing.

venues.name: Yard & Flagon
venues.notes: Broadway pub with rooftop patio. Not a regular live music venue; listed so aggregator events there resolve correctly.
venues.verificationNotes: Hotels.com Saskatoon nightlife guide.

venues.name: PiNK Bar and Lounge
venues.notes: DJs Friday/Saturday, drag karaoke midweek.
venues.verificationNotes: Hotels.com Saskatoon nightlife guide.

venues.name: The Refinery Arts & Spirit Centre
aliases: ON THE BOARDS at The Refinery
Emmanuel Anglican Church and The Refinery Arts and Spirit Centre
venues.notes: Multi-purpose arts space in the former St. James' parish hall: theatre, dance, folk concerts, open mics, workshops. Not fully wheelchair accessible per some presenters.
venues.verificationNotes: SaskMusic directory and multiple 2025–2026 event listings (SaskCulture, Discover Saskatoon).

venues.name: TCU Place
aliases: TCU Place - Saskatoon's Arts and Convention Centre
venues.notes: Arts & convention centre with the 2,003-seat Sid Buckwold Theatre; touring shows, comedy, Saskatoon Symphony concerts.
venues.verificationNotes: Wikipedia and Discover Saskatoon venue listing.

venues.name: SaskTel Centre
venues.notes: Arena: major concerts, Saskatoon Blades and Saskatchewan Rush games.
venues.verificationNotes: Discover Saskatoon gives 101-3515 Thatcher Ave; Wikipedia gives 3315 Thatcher Ave. Using the tourism listing.

venues.name: Persephone Theatre
aliases: Persephone Theatre at Remai Arts Centre
venues.address: Remai Arts Centre, 100 Spadina Cres E, Saskatoon, SK
venues.notes: Saskatchewan's largest regional theatre company; 450-seat main stage plus 100-seat second stage.
venues.verificationNotes: Official directions page and Wikipedia.

venues.name: Remai Modern
venues.address: 102 Spadina Cres E, Saskatoon, SK S7K 0L3
venues.notes: Modern and contemporary art museum with the 150-seat SaskTel Theatre; tours, family art-making, screenings.
venues.verificationNotes: Discover Saskatoon venue listing.

venues.name: Gather Local Market
venues.address: 414 Avenue B S, Saskatoon, SK S7M 1M8
venues.notes: Indoor market in the former Farmers' Market building; outdoor market May–Oct; occasional live music.
venues.verificationNotes: Official website (address and hours).

venues.name: Saskatoon Farmers' Market
venues.notes: Co-op farmers' market; moved from River Landing in 2020.
venues.verificationNotes: 211 Saskatchewan gives 2600 Koyl Ave; 2020 news reports gave the temporary address 2604 Koyl Ave. Current hours not verified.

venues.name: Fox & Hounds Pub and Brewery
venues.notes: Weekly 'POP QUIZ' trivia on Tuesdays (Eventbrite).
venues.verificationNotes: Address from a single secondary listing; needs confirmation.

venues.name: Knox United Church
venues.notes: Hosts Candlelight concert series (Fever) and choral concerts.
venues.verificationNotes: Venue named in AllEvents and Fever listings; street address not yet verified.

venues.name: Prairieland Park
venues.notes: Exhibition grounds: expos, trade shows, large concerts and festivals.
venues.verificationNotes: Named in Tourism Saskatoon and AllEvents listings; address not yet verified.

venues.name: Art Bar
venues.typicalAge: 19+ for most evening shows (stated per event)
venues.notes: Bar, small theatre and gallery in Riversdale: comedy, singer-songwriter and album-release shows, the Saskatoon Story Jam storytelling open mic (1st and 3rd Thursdays), drag and spoken word, paint nights. Also a Winterruption / WTPN festival venue (tickets via Broadway Theatre). Some promoters sell on Ticket Tailor (Bloom Entertainment).
venues.verificationNotes: Address, phone and website from the Riversdale business directory and Discover Saskatoon listings (2025-2026). A few listings give postal code S7M 1N4; most give S7M 0W8. The official site's event markup has not been inspected yet.

closedOrRenamed.name: Lydia's Pub
closedOrRenamed.note: Songkick marks the venue closed; Prairie Sun Brewery now occupies the corner. Events attributed to Lydia's are flagged rather than shown at a live venue.

closedOrRenamed.name: Vangelis Tavern
closedOrRenamed.note: Former occupant of 801 Broadway (now Black Cat Tavern).
